description: Build system-monitor tiles from selectable CPU, memory, storage, network, battery, sensor, and uptime metrics.
capabilities: Configure up to five pages per tile. Each page renders one to three metrics as bars or KPIs, or one to two metrics as a rolling chart.
Choose from 19 metric identifiers; supported views and availability depend on the metric and operating system. Unavailable readings are shown as unavailable rather than as zero.
On Apple Silicon, CPU/GPU temperature and fan readings require the optional macmon helper; other metrics also vary by platform.
